findings.title: Failed user-request completion can be accepted as a successful answer
evidence: tests/browser/guest-chat-store-acceptance.mjs:175-188 records only completion.status=success, then records end.reason=complete
tests/browser/guest-chat-completion-oracle.mjs:12-23 accepts end.reason=complete with matching text even when a completion event reported failure
/Volumes/Samsung2TB/code/aidream/aidream/services/ai_execution/ai_task.py:713-742 emits completion status=failed; lines 613-615 then call send_end() with default reason=complete
findings.impact: A real failed terminal run whose rendered text happens to contain the fixture code and requested terms can produce terminal_answer and a false Store acceptance pass. The source guard has no failed-completion case.
findings.minimal_source_reproduction: Wire sequence: completion {operation:'user_request',status:'failed'}, end {reason:'complete'}, done; one new assistant reply reads 'C82F4A Capture Understand Use'. The collector discards the failed completion. classifyGuestTurn({runs:[{done:true,delegated:false,error:false,endReason:'complete',userRequestCompleted:false,startReplyCount:0,doneAt:0}],assistantText:'C82F4A Capture Understand Use',replyCount:1,expectedTerms:['C82F4A','Capture','Understand','Use'],errorNotice:false}) returns terminal_answer by lines 13-23. This is a source-derived reproduction, not an executed native observation.
findings.required_repair: Record user_request completion success and failure per run, reject failure before considering end.reason, and prove both outcomes with distinct forcing inputs.

findings.title: Benign outstanding-delegated 409 is classified as terminal error
evidence: src/lib/api/stream.ts:254-255 forwards only resume_conflict as an error code
src/hooks/use-chat-stream.ts:657-703 treats a 409 on resume as a non-rendered pending-tool state
findings.impact: A resume attempted while another delegated call is unanswered gets an error chunk and done. The oracle returns terminal_error before a later tool result can resume the turn, yielding a false acceptance failure.
findings.minimal_source_reproduction: Wire sequence: stream:chunk {type:'error',payload:{status:409}} then done for a pending delegated call. The collector stores error=true,errorCode=null. classifyGuestTurn({runs:[{done:true,delegated:false,error:true,errorCode:null,endReason:null,startReplyCount:1,doneAt:0}],assistantText:'',replyCount:1,expectedTerms:['C82F4A'],errorNotice:false}) returns terminal_error at line 7, despite the client's 409 branch leaving pending cards active. This is a source-derived reproduction, not an executed native observation.
findings.required_repair: Carry the 409 status into the oracle and distinguish the retryable/pending protocol state from terminal failure; test a multi-tool suspended sequence through the runner seam.

verdict_b_doctrine_quality.test_quality: The five pure-helper cases include delegated handoff, wrong text, correct text, render gap, and generic error. They do not exercise the stream-message collector, failed completion, or the benign 409 path. The correct/wrong cases share a handcrafted completion shape with end.reason=complete; no captured live wire fixture or runtime observation validates this shape end to end.
verdict_b_doctrine_quality.resource_limit: No node tests or browser run were launched: stabilization policy requires guarded admission for test commands and the parent assigned the sole heavy permit elsewhere.
